item.title: Meal - Air Fryer Chicken Burritos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 600g
  • Rice - 2 cups cooked
  • Tortillas - 4
  • Cheese - 1 cup
  • Beans - 1 can
  • Salsa - 1/2 cup
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper
    • Paprika

Directions

  1. Cook and season chicken, then shred
  2. Mix with rice, beans and salsa
  3. Fill tortillas and roll tightly
  4. Air fry at 190°C for 10–12 mins until crispy

Macros

  • Calories - 610
  • Protein - 48g
  • Carbs - 55g
  • Fat - 20g

item.title: Meal - Air Fryer Nachos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Tortilla chips - 150–200g
  • Cheese - 1.5–2 cups (cheddar or blend)
  • Sweet corn - 1/2 cup
  • Bell peppers - 1 cup (chopped)
  • Onion - 1/2 (diced)
  • Jalapeños (optional)

Seasoning

  • Oregano
  • Chilli flakes
  • Salt (optional)

Optional Add-ons

  • Cooked beef or chicken
  • Beans
  • Sour cream
  • Guacamole
  • Salsa

Directions

  1. Line air fryer basket with parchment paper
  2. Add a layer of tortilla chips
  3. Top with vegetables, corn, and cheese
  4. Repeat layers if needed (chips → toppings → cheese)
  5. Sprinkle oregano and chilli flakes
  6. Air fry at 180°C for 5–7 minutes until cheese melts
  7. Remove and add optional toppings (sour cream, salsa, etc.)
  8. Serve immediately

Macros

  • Calories - 520
  • Protein - 18g
  • Carbs - 45g
  • Fat - 30g

Notes

  • Confirmed structure from reel + standard air fryer method :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
  • Best eaten fresh — chips soften quickly after cooking :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}
  • Easily adaptable with added protein for a full meal

item.title: Meal - Arayes
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g beef or lamb mince
  • 1 onion, grated and drained
  • 1 jalapeño, grated
  • 4 garlic cloves, grated
  • ¼ cup parsley, chopped
  • 1 tsp baharat
  • ½ tsp each cumin, paprika, salt and black pepper
  • 4 pita breads, halved
  • Olive oil

Directions

  1. Mix the mince with onion, jalapeño, garlic, parsley and spices.
  2. Spread a thin, even layer of filling inside each pita half.
  3. Brush the outside lightly with olive oil.
  4. Grill or pan-fry over medium heat for 4–5 minutes per side, then cook the open meat edge until the filling is cooked through.
  5. Serve hot with yoghurt or tahini sauce.

References

  • Original Instagram post — unavailable during extraction; recipe reconstructed from matching arayes references.

item.title: Meal - Beef Bulgogi Burrito
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g steak, very thinly sliced
  • 1 onion, grated
  • 1 Asian pear, grated
  • 2 tbsp soy sauce
  • ¼ cup brown sugar
  • 1 tsp sesame oil
  • 2 garlic cloves, grated
  • 2cm ginger, grated
  • 2 tbsp gochujang
  • 1 tbsp sesame seeds
  • 4 large burrito wraps
  • Cooked rice
  • Kimchi
  • Sliced spring onion
  • Kewpie mayonnaise

Directions

  1. Mix beef with onion, pear, soy, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, gochujang and sesame seeds.
  2. Marinate for at least 2 hours.
  3. Stir-fry the beef in batches over high heat for 2–3 minutes.
  4. Layer rice, kimchi, beef, mayonnaise and spring onion on each wrap.
  5. Roll tightly and toast in a dry pan or sandwich press.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Big Mac Toastie
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Bread slices - 4
  • Ground beef - 300g
  • Cheese - 4 slices
  • Pickles - to taste
  • Onion - 1/4 (finely diced)
  • Lettuce - 1 cup (shredded)
  • Butter - 1 tbsp

Big Mac Sauce

  • Mayonnaise - 3 tbsp
  • Ketchup - 1 tbsp
  • Mustard - 1 tsp
  • Pickle juice - 1 tsp
  • Paprika - pinch

Directions

  1. Cook ground beef in a pan, breaking it up and seasoning with salt and pepper
  2. Mix all Big Mac sauce ingredients in a small bowl
  3. Butter the outside of the bread slices
  4. On the inside, layer beef, cheese, pickles, onion, lettuce and sauce
  5. Close sandwich and cook in a pan or sandwich press until golden and crispy
  6. Slice and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 680
  • Protein - 38g
  • Carbs - 42g
  • Fat - 38g

Notes

  • Corrected from previous misclassification (was incorrectly labelled as a chicken wrap)
  • Classic fast-food style toastie — high calorie, high fat

item.title: Meal - Bolognese Tacos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g beef mince
  • 1 large onion, chopped
  • 1 medium carrot, grated
  • 4 garlic cloves, chopped
  • 1 tsp each oregano, thyme, basil and garlic powder
  • 2 tsp each sweet paprika and dried parsley
  • Salt and black pepper
  • 1 tbsp tomato purée
  • 1½ cups tomato passata
  • ⅓ cup water
  • ½ vegetable stock cube
  • Grated cheddar
  • 5–6 mini tortilla wraps
  • ½ tbsp olive oil

Directions

  1. Soften the onion in olive oil, add the beef and brown over high heat for 5–6 minutes.
  2. Add garlic, carrot, passata, tomato purée, seasonings, stock and water.
  3. Cover and simmer for 15–20 minutes.
  4. Dip each tortilla in the sauce, place it in a hot pan, and layer with cheese and 2–3 tbsp of filling.
  5. Fold and grill both sides until browned and crisp.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Cheese Pull Apart Bread
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Bread loaf (sourdough or cob) - 1
  • Mozzarella - 200g (cubed or shredded)
  • Butter - 3 tbsp (melted)
  • Garlic - 2 cloves (minced)
  • Parsley (optional)
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper

Directions

  1. Cut the bread in a crosshatch pattern (do not slice all the way through)
  2. Stuff mozzarella into the cuts throughout the loaf
  3. Mix melted butter with garlic and seasoning
  4. Pour or brush mixture over the bread, ensuring it gets into the gaps
  5. Wrap loosely in foil and bake at 180°C for 15 minutes
  6. Uncover and bake another 5–10 minutes until crispy and melted
  7. Serve immediately and pull apart

Macros

  • Calories - 420
  • Protein - 14g
  • Carbs - 38g
  • Fat - 24g

Notes

  • Identified based on “cheese pull” style construction
  • Designed for visual melt/stretch rather than high-protein efficiency
  • Best served immediately while cheese is hot and elastic

item.title: Meal - Cheesy Bacon Jalapeño Popper Wrap
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Cream cheese, softened
  • Grated cheddar
  • Grated mozzarella

  • Jalapeños, grilled and sliced

Directions

  1. Mix cream cheese, cheddar, mozzarella, bacon and jalapeños.

  3. Fold the sides inward and roll tightly.

item.title: Meal - Chicken & Chorizo One Pan Rice
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 600g (diced)
  • Chorizo - 120–150g (sliced)
  • Rice - 250–300g (uncooked, rinsed)
  • Onion - 1 (diced)
  • Red and yellow peppers - 2 (chopped)
  • Garlic - 3 cloves (minced)
  • Chicken stock - 500–700ml
  • Tomato paste - 2 tbsp
  • Oil - 1 tbsp

Seasoning

  • Smoked paprika - 2 tsp
  • Garlic powder - 1 tsp
  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Chilli (optional)

Directions

  1. Heat oil in a large pan and cook chorizo until it releases oils
  2. Add onion, peppers, and garlic, cooking until softened
  3. Add chicken and cook until browned
  4. Stir in tomato paste and seasoning
  5. Add rice and mix to coat in flavours
  6. Pour in chicken stock and bring to a simmer
  7. Cover and cook for 15–20 minutes until rice is tender and liquid absorbed
  8. Fluff and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 600
  • Protein - 45g
  • Carbs - 60g
  • Fat - 18g

Notes

  • Confirmed from indexed reel + multiple matching recipes :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4}
  • Similar to simplified paella-style cooking (one-pan absorption method)
  • Very strong meal prep option

item.title: Meal - Chicken Alfredo Tortellini
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 1 lb
  • Butter - 2 tbsp
  • Garlic - 1 tbsp minced
  • Frozen tortellini - 19 oz bag
  • Alfredo sauce - 15 oz jar
  • Mozzarella - 1 1/2 cups shredded
  • Bacon - 6 pieces
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper
    • Onion powder
    • Paprika
    • Italian seasoning

Directions

  1. Cook the bacon until crisp, then set aside
  2. Season the chicken and cook in the butter until browned and cooked through
  3. Add the garlic and cook briefly until fragrant
  4. Add the frozen tortellini and Alfredo sauce and stir to combine
  5. Simmer until the tortellini is cooked through
  6. Stir through the mozzarella until melted
  7. Crumble the bacon over the top and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 552 per serving
  • Protein - 44g
  • Carbs - 29g
  • Fat - 30g

Notes

  • Macros are estimated from the ingredient list visible in the reel

item.title: Meal - Chicken Bacon Ranch Burrito
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 1.3kg chicken breast
  • Taco seasoning
  • 500g low-fat cottage cheese
  • 2 tbsp ranch seasoning
  • 1 tsp chipotle in adobo
  • Juice of ½ lime
  • 2 garlic cloves
  • 45ml light mayonnaise
  • 200g light mozzarella
  • 8 bacon rashers, cooked and diced
  • Chives
  • 1kg cooked rice
  • 10 large tortillas

Directions

  1. Season and cook the chicken, then dice it.
  2. Blend cottage cheese, ranch seasoning, chipotle, lime, garlic and mayonnaise until smooth.
  3. Combine chicken with the ranch sauce, mozzarella, bacon and chives.
  4. Warm each tortilla, add rice and chicken filling, then roll tightly.
  5. Toast immediately or wrap and freeze for later.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Chicken Gnocchi Soup
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 500g
  • Tomato puree - 3 tbsp
  • Sun dried tomatoes - 6 (chopped)
  • Chicken stock - 1L
  • Natural yogurt - 500g
  • Parmesan - 50g (grated)
  • Gnocchi - 400g
  • Spinach - 1 handful
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper

Directions

  1. Cook the chicken in a pot until lightly browned, then remove and chop if needed
  2. Add the tomato puree and sun dried tomatoes and cook briefly
  3. Pour in the chicken stock and bring to a simmer
  4. Add the gnocchi and cook until tender
  5. Lower the heat and stir through the yogurt and Parmesan
  6. Return the chicken to the pot and add the spinach
  7. Simmer gently until the spinach wilts and the soup is hot throughout
  8. Serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 490 per serving
  • Protein - 52g
  • Carbs - 48g
  • Fat - 10g

Notes

  • Macros come from the reel caption

  4. Fold into wraps and place seam-side down on a lined tray.

item.title: Meal - Chili Garlic Noodles
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Ground pork - 1/2 lb
  • Oil - 1 tbsp
  • Garlic - 6 cloves (minced)
  • Onion - 1/4 (finely chopped)
  • Noodles - 300g
  • Seasoning
    • Garlic powder - 1 tsp
    • Salt - 1/2 tsp
    • Pepper
    • Chilli flakes
  • Sauce
    • Soy sauce
    • Chilli oil
    • Brown sugar

Directions

  1. Cook the noodles and set aside
  2. Heat the oil in a pan and cook the ground pork until browned
  3. Add the garlic and onion and cook until fragrant and softened

item.title: Meal - Chili Mac and Cheese
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Olive oil - 1 tbsp
  • Garlic - 2 cloves (minced)
  • Onion - 1 (finely chopped)
  • Red bell pepper - 1 (chopped)
  • Lean ground beef - 500g
  • Diced tomatoes - 1 can

  2. Add the ground beef and cook until browned
  3. Stir through the chilli powder, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper

item.title: Meal - Chipotle Beef & Crispy Chorizo Gnocchi
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Gnocchi - 500g
  • Beef mince - 400g
  • Chorizo - 100–150g
  • Tinned chopped tomatoes - 400g
  • Onion - 1/2 (diced)
  • Garlic - 1 tsp (or 2 cloves)
  • Chipotle paste - 1 tsp
  • Oil - 1 tbsp
  • Chilli powder - 1/2 tsp
  • Cheese (optional, grated)
  • Fresh herbs (optional)
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper
    • Sugar - 1/2 tsp

Directions

  1. Add gnocchi to air fryer, drizzle with oil and chilli powder, and cook at 190°C for ~18 minutes until crispy
  2. Dice and cook chorizo in a pan until crispy, then remove and set aside
  3. In the same pan, sauté onion and garlic until softened
  4. Add beef mince and cook for ~5–7 minutes until browned
  5. Stir in chipotle paste, chopped tomatoes, salt, pepper, and sugar
  6. Simmer sauce for several minutes until slightly thickened
  7. Add crispy gnocchi and cooked chorizo back into the pan and mix well
  8. Optional: top with grated cheese and fresh herbs before serving

item.title: Meal - Chorizo Smash Breakfast Tacos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chorizo - 300g
  • Small tortillas - 6
  • Eggs - 3
  • Cheddar cheese - 1 cup (shredded)
  • Bacon - 3–4 rashers (optional)
  • Onion - 1 (caramelised)

Sauce (optional)

  • Mayonnaise
  • Hot sauce
  • Mustard or similar tangy sauce

Directions

  1. Press chorizo directly onto tortillas in a thin layer
  2. Cook meat-side down in a hot pan until crispy
  3. Flip tortillas and crack egg on top (or cook eggs separately)
  4. Add cheese and allow to melt
  5. Top with bacon and caramelised onion
  6. Fold and serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 620
  • Protein - 32g
  • Carbs - 38g
  • Fat - 38g

Notes

  • Confirmed from indexed reel description :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
  • “Smash taco” method = meat pressed into tortilla and cooked together
  • Breakfast-focused variation of viral smash taco trend

item.title: Meal - Feta Fried Egg Tortilla
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Egg - 1
  • Feta cheese - 2 tbsp (crumbled)
  • Tortilla - 1 small
  • Avocado - 1/4 (sliced)
  • Chilli oil - drizzle (optional)

Directions

  1. Sprinkle feta in a circle in a hot pan
  2. Once it starts melting, crack the egg into the centre
  3. Place tortilla on top and press down gently
  4. Cook until the egg sets and feta crisps
  5. Flip so tortilla side is down and toast briefly
  6. Remove, top with avocado and chilli oil
  7. Fold and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 380
  • Protein - 18g
  • Carbs - 28g
  • Fat - 22g

Notes

  • Confirmed from indexed recipe content :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}
  • Very fast, high-flavour breakfast or snack
  • Texture comes from crispy feta + soft egg contrast

item.title: Meal - Garlic Butter Jalapeño Popper Croissants
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Jalapeños - 6 (halved, deseeded)
  • Cheddar cheese - 1 cup (shredded)
  • Croissant dough - 1 tube
  • Butter - 2 tbsp (melted)
  • Garlic - 2 cloves (minced)
  • Parsley (optional)

Directions

  1. Slice jalapeños in half and remove seeds
  2. Fill each with shredded cheddar cheese
  3. Wrap each jalapeño with croissant dough
  4. Mix melted butter with garlic and brush over wrapped poppers
  5. Bake at 180°C for 15–20 minutes until golden
  6. Garnish with parsley and serve

Macros

  • Calories - 420
  • Protein - 12g
  • Carbs - 28g
  • Fat - 28g

Notes

  • Originally misclassified as a chicken caesar bowl — corrected based on reel content
  • High-fat, indulgent snack rather than high-protein meal

item.title: Meal - Garlic Honey BBQ Pulled Chicken Tacos
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 700g boneless chicken breast
  • 1 cup BBQ sauce
  • ¼ cup honey
  • 4 garlic cloves, minced
  • 1 tsp each onion powder and smoked paprika
  • Salt and black pepper
  • 8 small tortillas
  • Coleslaw mix
  • Chopped coriander
  • Lime wedges

Directions

  1. Coat the chicken with BBQ sauce, honey, garlic, onion powder, paprika, salt and pepper.
  2. Cook covered on low until tender, then shred and mix it back through the sauce.
  3. Warm the tortillas and fill with pulled chicken and coleslaw.
  4. Finish with coriander and lime.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Giant Chicken Poppers
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken mince - 500g
  • Lite Laughing Cow Cheese - 4 wedges
  • Cornflakes - 60g
  • Greek Yogurt - 150g
  • Seasoning
    • Buffalo Chicken
    • Garlic
    • Paprika

Directions

  1. Mix chicken mince with seasonings in a large glass bowl
  2. Cover a piece of cheese with mince mix and roll into a ball
  3. Make more balls with cheese in the middle until the mince is gone
  4. Place the balls into the freezer for 30-60 minutes
  5. Blend the cornflakes with additional seasoning
  6. Roll the chicken balls in Greek yogurt
  7. Roll the chicken balls in the cornflake and seasoning mix
  8. Spray the chicken balls with oil
  9. Cook in the air fryer for 15-20 minutes, turning every 5 minutes

Macros

  • Calories - 254 per serving
  • Protein - 36g
  • Carbs - 16g
  • Fat - 4g

Notes

  • Macros are estimated from the ingredients used in the original template

item.title: Meal - Grilled Cheese Burrito
item.description:
Ingredients

  • 500g beef mince
  • Taco seasoning
  • 1 cup cooked seasoned rice
  • 1 cup grated cheddar, plus extra for grilling
  • 1 cup queso or nacho cheese sauce
  • ¼ cup chipotle sauce
  • 1 cup sour cream
  • Crushed tortilla strips
  • 8 large tortillas

Directions

  1. Brown the beef, add taco seasoning and cook until the sauce has reduced.
  2. Layer beef, rice, queso, cheddar, chipotle sauce, sour cream and tortilla strips on each wrap.
  3. Roll tightly into burritos.
  4. Scatter cheese in a hot non-stick pan and place each burrito seam-side down over it.
  5. Turn once the cheese forms a golden crust and toast the other side.

References

  • Original Instagram recipe

item.title: Meal - Hash Brown Feta Bites
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Hash browns (frozen or shredded potato) - 400g
  • Feta cheese - 150g (crumbled or cubed)
  • Egg - 1
  • Flour or breadcrumbs - 2 tbsp (optional, for binding)
  • Oil spray or drizzle
  • Seasoning
    • Salt
    • Pepper
    • Garlic powder
    • Paprika

Directions

  1. If using frozen hash browns, thaw slightly
  2. Mix hash browns with egg, seasoning, and optional binder
  3. Form small portions and press feta into the centre (or mix feta through)
  4. Shape into balls or patties
  5. Place on a lined tray and lightly spray with oil
  6. Bake at 200°C for 20–25 minutes, flipping halfway, until crispy
  7. Serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 340
  • Protein - 12g
  • Carbs - 30g
  • Fat - 20g

Notes

  • Confirmed as a feta + hash brown bite-style recipe
  • Likely variations include coating feta in hash browns or mixing through
  • Good as a snack, side, or brunch item

item.title: Meal - Hash Brown, Halloumi & Chorizo Hash
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Hash browns (frozen or pre-cooked) - 400g
  • Halloumi - 200g (cubed)
  • Chorizo - 150g (sliced)
  • Eggs - 3–4
  • Onion - 1/2 (diced)
  • Garlic - 2 cloves (minced)
  • Oil - 1 tbsp

Seasoning

  • Salt
  • Pepper
  • Smoked paprika
  • Chilli flakes (optional)

Directions

  1. Cook hash browns in a large pan until crispy and golden, then set aside
  2. In the same pan, cook chorizo until it releases oils and crisps
  3. Add onion and garlic, cooking until softened
  4. Add halloumi and cook until golden on all sides
  5. Return hash browns to the pan and mix everything together
  6. Create small wells and crack eggs into the pan
  7. Cover and cook until eggs reach desired doneness
  8. Serve hot

Macros

  • Calories - 620
  • Protein - 32g
  • Carbs - 35g
  • Fat - 40g

Notes

  • Confirmed from reel caption (halloumi + chorizo + hash brown combination) :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}
  • Rich, high-fat breakfast or brunch dish
  • Can be adapted with veggies (spinach, peppers) for balance

item.title: Meal - Healthy Chicken Nuggets
item.description:
Ingredients

  • Chicken breast - 500g
